name: Energia C3045

origin.basis: CST is the Cheng Shin (正新) brand of Taiwan's Cheng Shin Rubber; China listings give the brand as CST/正新.

manufacturing.basis: The listings do not state the factory; Cheng Shin also makes bicycle tires at a mainland plant.

positioning: Budget 120 TPI folding road tire with a dual-compound tread and puncture layer, popular in China as a training tire.
weight_basis: No weight is given in the listing.

wet_notes.summary: One owner felt its water-channel tread cleared wet roads faster than a Continental GSR.

community.summary: Recommended over the Continental GSR: similar grip, lighter and closer to nominal width.
Commenters found it very hard to mount and reported longitudinal slipping.

availability.note: Widely sold by mainland Taobao and Tmall shops; no official CST store was found, and CST's international site no longer showed model pages on 2026-11-01.

price_observations.market: 云天 优质正品 (Taobao shop)
price_observations.conditions: Taobao/Tmall shop list price on 2026-11-01; shipping within mainland China. The listing does not say whether an option is one tire or a pair.

caveats: A separate C3045N tubeless version is sold (CNY 108 at the same shop).
No independent lab test found; specifications come from seller listings.
